designRules: No automatic preset may contain a risk=Alto tweak.
Balanceado favors stability, reversibility and preservation of common Windows features.
Gamer adds general gaming/latency tuning but leaves game-specific IFEO/affinity choices outside the automatic preset.
Extremo is aggressive but still does not automatically disable core security, Windows Update, Defender, VBS/HVCI or CPU vulnerability mitigations.
User-choice, hardware-specific, workload-specific, maintenance and diagnostic actions are classified outside automatic presets.
ConflictPolicy remains Block; preset composition must be conflict-free before it reaches the Planner.

Balanceado.description: Otimização conservadora para uso diário: remove bloat evidente, reduz telemetria e atividade em segundo plano, preserva recursos comuns e não aplica nenhum tweak de risco Alto.
principles: Exact backup/undo remains mandatory at execution time.
High-risk tweaks never enter automatic presets.
Hardware/workload-specific tweaks remain conditional or manual.
Declared conflicts are resolved explicitly before Planner execution.

Gamer.description: Parte do Balanceado e acrescenta otimizações gerais de jogos/latência com bom perfil de reversibilidade. Não remove a pilha Xbox/Game Pass e evita tweaks dependentes de hardware ou jogo específico.
principles: Exact backup/undo remains mandatory at execution time.
High-risk tweaks never enter automatic presets.
Hardware/workload-specific tweaks remain conditional or manual.
Declared conflicts are resolved explicitly before Planner execution.

Extremo.description: Perfil agressivo e ainda transacional: amplia debloat, privacidade e redução de recursos. Não desativa Defender, VBS/HVCI, mitigacões de CPU, Windows Update nem aplica tweaks de risco Alto automaticamente.
principles: Exact backup/undo remains mandatory at execution time.
High-risk tweaks never enter automatic presets.
Hardware/workload-specific tweaks remain conditional or manual.
Declared conflicts are resolved explicitly before Planner execution.

conflictResolutions.rationale: Extremo desativa hibernação; Balanceado/Gamer apenas desativam Fast Startup. Nunca selecionar os dois.
Balanceado/Gamer mantêm pesquisa como ícone; Extremo oculta pesquisa e Task View.
A remoção definitiva continua manual-only; Extremo pode usar somente a variante reversível.
Nenhum preset automático pausa Windows Update por anos.
